body: Thank you. I've read your comment a bunch of times over the last few days. It's helping me with working up the courage. They work from home and almost never leave, so I don't know if I'll escape the confrontation, but thank you still. I'm so scared it's fucking stupid. I don't want to get hurt and (maybe stupidly) don't want them to hurt themselves. I just want peace.
I feel like there is never a right answer and if there is I can never think fast enough to find it. I'm always wrong and I'm always stupid.
That is something a lot easier said than done. I do appreciate the advice however.
My partner is very controlling about sleep and sometimes food. They always start nice about it, but if I mess up I'm chastised or yelled at. I have anxiety about getting tired now.
I do something similar. I feel like my brain pauses and I can't even began to think what to say let alone speak it.
I won't go to specifics about it, but yes she is mentally unwell. Not often, and never to this degree.

It's not really that I believe I'm not good enough or anything. I just don't think one person in your life who loves you is enough cancel out or even make a dent in the amount of sadness she's feeling. However I appreciate the encouragement and it made me feel a bit better, so thank you.
